content: In order to evaluate our classifiers, we perform 4-fold cross validation on a shuffled data set. Table TABREF10 shows the F1 micro and F1 macro scores for all the classifiers. The KNN classifier seem to perform the best across all four metrics. This is probably due to the multi-class nature of the data set.
